subject: Lightricks LTX-2 provider admission and LTX-Video legacy treatment
rationale: LTX-2 exposes useful text/image/video conditioning, synchronized audio-video, retake, keyframe interpolation, lip-dub, IC-LoRA and upscale pipelines that project into the existing provider-neutral FA3 video contracts.

The existing VideoGenerationIR, VideoRegenerationIntent, TemporalEditDescriptor, AudioDialoguePlan, AudioSceneDescriptor and AVSyncConstraint already cover the admitted semantics, so no new capability or authority is justified.
LTX multi-GPU inference is documented as a latency optimization rather than a memory aggregation mechanism, so FA3 must not model heterogeneous GPU VRAM as additive capacity.
LTX model and code use is governed by version-sensitive Lightricks community licenses; exact-version license admission must remain fail closed and separate from technical conformance.
Current-host production promotion requires real local E2E generation, QC and provenance evidence and cannot be inferred from upstream documentation or static conformance.
adopted: native ltx-pipelines as an integration target
ComfyUI integration through the existing FA3 ComfyUI boundary
CPU offload as preferred VRAM-constrained fallback and disk offload as secondary fallback
exact-version license and artifact admission before runtime activation
not_adopted_as_canonical: LTX as workflow or model-routing authority
audio-only t2a pipeline inside the video authority
floating upstream main as runtime promotion evidence
automatic license inheritance from LTX-2.3 to LTX-2.5 or later
unconditional FP8 support on all NVIDIA GPUs

legacy_policy.reason: LTX-2 is the upstream primary development line and legacy LTX-Video capabilities must not create a parallel FA3 authority or duplicate provider semantics.
